notes.title: Interlinked Open Beta
notes.notes:
In honor of the Capitalism & Economy Fest, I invite you to join the first open beta of Interlinked! Be among the first to experience the open beta and dive into the game's extended tutorial, offering a glimpse of what the future demo might look like. Your participation is crucial as I seek valuable feedback and aim to identify any lurking bugs.

Join me in shaping the future of Interlinked—one step at a time. Stay tuned for upcoming betas featuring even more thrilling content!
